subject: Warm-pass: HelixHealth deployment readiness & primary steward nomination
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Eli Tanaka <eli.tanaka@helixhealth.com>, Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@helixhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-19T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Warm-pass: HelixHealth deployment readiness & primary steward nomination

Eli / Ravi —

Thanks again for signing the SOW — attached here for records (HelixHealth_SOW_signed.pdf). We want to get the warm-pass to CS completed this week so you have a single point of contact for rollout and the initial 30-day acceptance gates. Key milestones we need to confirm:

- Network & egress requirements validated (network_requirements.xlsx attached)
- Test dataset and onboarding prompts delivery by 5/24
- Initial dedicated capacity reservation for week of 6/3
- Integration runbook (Doc in Drive) and a short tech sync to confirm credentials

Ben — can you do the official warm-pass to CS and add the MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v2.docx to the HubSpot record?

Monica / Tessa — tagging you as potential stewards. Our ask is: nominate a primary steward who will own the 30-day checklist and be the escalation contact. If you can confirm steward and availability for a 30-minute kickoff next week, I’ll lock in times with Helix.

Eli — quick note on procurement: they indicated a single PO is on the way, but we should still capture billing contact so we can coordinate invoicing.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Sales to upload final docs to HubSpot (Ben) — today
2) Primary steward assigned (CS) — by EOD 5/20
3) Tech sync to validate network and creds (Jordan + CloudOps) — target 5/23

Thanks —
Jordan
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: HelixHealth_SOW_signed.pdf (PDF, 1MB), network_requirements.xlsx (XLSX, 45KB), MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN_v2.docx (DOCX, 120KB)

From: Eli Tanaka <eli.tanaka@helixhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@helixhealth.com>, Procurement <procurement@helixhealth.com>
Date: 2028-05-19T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Warm-pass: HelixHealth deployment readiness & primary steward nomination

Jordan — thanks. Confirming receipt of the SOW. Ravi (Director of Data Ops) will lead the technical side; I’ll copy procurement for billing.

Quick answers:
- Procurement: PO in process, expect by 5/25.
- Network: Alyssa from our CloudOps partner will join the tech sync — forwarding her contact to you.
- Test data: We should be able to package an anonymized sample dataset by 5/23.

We’re available for a 30-minute kickoff any day the week of 5/23; prefer mornings PT.

Best,
Eli
Head of Product, HelixHealth

Forwarded: Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@cloudops-partner.com>

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-05-20T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: INTERNAL: HelixHealth warm-pass — steward nomination and kickoff slots

Monica / Tessa — internal note following Eli’s reply. Helix is expecting a steward and a 30-min tech kickoff next week. They plan to have PO by 5/25 and test data by 5/23. Key risks I see: network egress IPs (requires JW token allowlist in their firewall), and early spike in token usage during acceptance tests.

Proposed steward: Monica Patel (Primary) / Tessa Morgan (Backup). Monica, can you confirm you can run the 30-day acceptance plan and lead the kickoff? If yes, I’ll introduce you to their team and schedule the tech sync.

Notes for handoff (to include in the warm-pass doc):
- Usage profile: expected burst tests first 2 weeks ~ 2–3M tokens/day, steady state ~ 300–400k tokens/day thereafter.
- SLA expectations: 99.9% p95 latency targets for inference routes; backup policy: fallback to a smaller variant (gpt-small-quant) in peak events.
- Security: Helix requires SOC2 evidence and KMS integration detail — Ben has uploaded initial artifacts to the HubSpot drive.
- Who owns what: Sales owns billing/P0 until PO clears; CS owns acceptance gating and escalation post-warm-pass.

If Monica can accept, Ben will finalize doc upload and I will loop Helix in.

—Jordan

(On Fri, May 19, 2028 at 09:14 AM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com> wrote: see above)

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Eli Tanaka <eli.tanaka@helixhealth.com>, Ravi Shah <ravi.shah@helixhealth.com>, Alyssa Greene <alyssa.greene@cloudops-partner.com>
Date: 2028-05-22T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Warm-pass: HelixHealth deployment readiness & primary steward nomination

Jordan / all — happy to take primary stewardship. I’ll own the 30-day acceptance checklist and act as Helix’s main CS contact.

Planned immediate actions:
1) Schedule 30-minute kickoff with Eli/Ravi/Alyssa — propose 5/23 09:30 PT or 5/24 10:00 PT. I’ll send a calendar invite after Ben confirms docs are in HubSpot.
2) Meet with our SRE/CloudOps (cc Alyssa) to validate the network matrix and define allowlist steps.
3) Prepare the acceptance runbook and pre-flight checklist; share with Helix by EOD 5/24.

Risk mitigations I’ll include in the runbook:
- Temporary scaling buffer for initial burst tests (enable burst capacity for first 72 hours)
- Rollback plan to a lower-cost model if latency or quality regressions occur during acceptance
- A single escalation path to Engineering on P0 — Tessa, can you confirm the on-call contact for escalation?

Ben — once the PO is posted in HubSpot, please confirm billing contact for invoicing.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0137

Attachments referenced: acceptance_runbook_template.md (stub), stewardship-checklist.xlsx (stub)
